$comment: Size budgets for the release artifacts, in bytes, enforced by `npm run measure:size` in ci.yml and release.yml on the packed tarballs.

served_total is what a browser downloads to initialize through the glue: the .wasm and its .js glue. gzip is fflate 0.8.3 at level 9 (pinned, so identical on every machine; Node's own zlib differs by build and CPU) and brotli is quality 11, window 22; both are laboratory sizes, not what a server sends.

scolta_core_slim_bg.wasm.gz is the slim module pre-gzipped by scripts/build.sh (zopfli, 15 iterations). It is already compressed, so only its raw size is budgeted: that is what crosses the wire from any server. served_pregzipped_total is what a browser downloads through the loader: the .gz at its raw size under every key, plus the loader and the glue as JavaScript a server may compress.

Each budget is the measured size plus about 2% headroom (the small loader gets a little more), measured 2026-10-03 with rustc 1.98.1, wasm-pack 0.15.0 and wasm-bindgen 0.2.126 (the versions ci.yml pins). Open core PR #70 adds 2,872 Brotli bytes to the full artifact and none to slim, inside this headroom.
Raise a budget only deliberately, in the same PR as the growth, and say why in the CHANGELOG.
